+++ b/internal/stats/average.go
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+package stats
+
+func Average(values []int) int {
+	sum := 0
+	for _, value := range values {
+		sum += value
+	}
+	return sum / len(values)
+}

+++ b/internal/file/read.go
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+package file
+
+func Read(root, name string) ([]byte, error) {
+	if filepath.IsAbs(name) || strings.Contains(name, "..") {
+		return nil, errors.New("invalid path")
+	}
+	path := filepath.Join(root, name)
+	return os.ReadFile(path)
+}

diff --git a/internal/store/update.go b/internal/store/update.go
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/internal/store/update.go
+++ b/internal/store/update.go
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+package store
+
+func Update(tx *sql.Tx, id int64, name string) error {
+	if _, err := tx.Exec("UPDATE users SET name = ? WHERE id = ?", name, id); err != nil {
+		_ = tx.Rollback()
+		return err
+	}
+	return tx.Commit()
+}
